gloss: strategy guide; walkthrough book (for a video game)

definitions.gloss: strategy guide; walkthrough book (a printed guide explaining how to clear a video game)
definitions.explanation: A printed book that explains how to progress through and complete a video game, typically including maps, item lists, enemy data, and step-by-step walkthroughs. Once a major category of gaming publication; with widespread internet access such guides are now more often found online, but printed {攻略本|こうりゃくぼん} are still released for major titles.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}→攻略：12824_kouryaku⟧ ('capturing; conquering; clearing (a game)') and {本|ほん} ('book'). The reading of {本|ぼん} is rendaku'd.

USAGE:
- Informal, conversational word; freely used in everyday speech by gamers of all ages.
- Applies only to printed books; an online walkthrough site is usually called ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}→攻略：12824_kouryaku⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧ or ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}→攻略：12824_kouryaku⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧, not {攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}.
- Carries no negative connotation on its own, but some gamers pride themselves on finishing a game {攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ ('without a guide').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a strategy guide
- {攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to consult a strategy guide
- {攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on a strategy guide
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧{攻略本|こうりゃくぼん}: official strategy guide

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}→攻略：12824_kouryaku⟧: capture; clearing a game — the base noun; also used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb.
- ⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}→攻略：12824_kouryaku⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: walkthrough website — online equivalent.
- ガイドブック: guidebook — general-purpose guidebook, most often for travel.
- ⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧: instruction manual — comes with the product; describes how to operate it, not how to beat it.
